ownership_change.before: LayerGpuCache owns expanded K, expanded V, and DSA index-key buffers.
ownership_change.after: LayerGpuCache owns only expanded K/V; ResidentSession independently owns one DSA index-key buffer per layer.
ownership_change.reason: A compact-vs-expanded attention-state variant must be able to replace expanded K/V while retaining the existing DSA index history without duplicating it.
default_per_layer_buffers: expanded keys: capacity * n_heads * qk_dim * sizeof(f32)
expanded values: capacity * n_heads * v_head_dim * sizeof(f32)
DSA index keys: capacity * index_head_dim * sizeof(f32)
ownership_change.ordinary_forward_change: None. indexer_topk receives the same buffer and capacity through explicit arguments instead of through LayerGpuCache.

promotion_gate.reason: This is an ownership-only prerequisite. ResidentSession still constructs expanded K/V and no compact runtime path is reachable.
next_required_mechanisms: default-inert mutually exclusive compact-vs-expanded ResidentSession attention state
live compact tensor binding and stable DSA-ranked index upload
